summary: Close-intake remains blocked by the required review gate. I reviewed the run artifacts and found only Solution Architect review outcomes of `defects` with defect counts 1 and 2. blocker.title: Passing Solution Architect review missing
blocker.reason: Close-intake cannot proceed because the required Solution Architect review has not passed. Evidence in the run directory shows both available Solution Architect review artifacts ended with defects: `solution-review-1-review-solution-attempt-1.json` and `solution-review-1-review-solution-attempt-2.json`. Later delivery and iteration review artifacts succeeded, and the latest human direction says to run Solution Architect review and retry close-intake after it passes, but no passing Solution Architect review artifact is present yet.

decisions.question: How should this intake proceed before close-intake is retried?
choices: Run Solution Architect review and retry close-intake after it passes
Override the close gate using the accepted-risk decision
Return to delivery remediation for more changes
decisions.recommended: Run Solution Architect review and retry close-intake after it passes
